Button.notes: primary: bg-primary text-background hover darken; secondary: bg-secondary text-background; outline: border-primary text-primary bg-transparent hover:bg-primary/10. Padding px-6 py-3, radius rounded-full for warm artisanal feel.

ProductCard.notes: surface bg-surface rounded (radius), shadow-sm hover:shadow-md, image aspect-square rounded-t, category tag as small pill in accent color, price in fontDisplay semibold, description in muted text-sm.

Nav.notes: bg-background/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-muted/20, logo in fontDisplay text-primary, links text-text hover:text-primary, sticky top-0.

Footer.notes: bg-primary text-background, links text-background/80 hover:text-background, fontBody, padding py-12, columns for nav/contact/social.
